_doc: Atestiguacion frase por frase — topic movies. Comunicacion real sobre cine/series (ir al cine, gustos, proponer, recomendar, opinar conversacionalmente, series/streaming). Retirada la prosa de critico/teoria filmica.
retired: 8 C2 de teoria filmica + 4 C1 de ensayo (ver movies-provenance.json)

en.movies_bad_ending.intent: I didn't like the ending of that movie.

en.movies_binge_watching_cant_stop.intent: I've been watching this series all week and I just can't stop.

en.movies_book_adaptation_missing_scenes.intent: I was disappointed that the book adaptation left out so many key scenes.

en.movies_casting_was_perfect_choice.intent: I had doubts about the casting, but that actor turned out to be perfect.

en.movies_character_arc_fully_earned.intent: By the final act, the character's transformation felt fully earned. Nothing seemed forced.

en.movies_character_motivations_hard_to_.intent: The plot was interesting, but the characters' motivations were hard to believe.

en.movies_cinematography_worth_watching.intent: The cinematography alone makes it worth watching. Every frame looks like a painting.

en.movies_classic_movie.intent: That movie is a classic, you have to watch it.

en.movies_disappointed_last_season.intent: I didn't like the last season of that series, it disappointed me.

en.movies_documentary_streaming.intent: I heard that documentary is excellent. Is it on any streaming platform?

en.movies_dont_understand_popularity.intent: I don't like that series, I don't understand why it's so popular.

en.movies_dubbed_or_subtitled.intent: Is the movie dubbed or subtitled?

en.movies_editing_creates_tension.intent: The editing in the opening sequence is masterful. The rhythm of the cuts creates unbearable tension.

en.movies_film_festival_city.intent: There is a new film festival in the city, shall we go?

en.movies_go_cinema_weekend.intent: I want to go to the movies this weekend, what movie do you want to see?

en.movies_good_actor.intent: This actor is very good, I like all his movies.

en.movies_good_movie_recommend.intent: This movie is very good, you should watch it.

en.movies_looking_new_series.intent: I'm looking for a new series to watch, can you recommend one?

en.movies_midnight_premiere_sells_out.intent: Should we go to the midnight premiere? Tickets sell out fast.

en.movies_new_director_movie.intent: There is a new movie by my favorite director, I have to watch it.

en.movies_nominated_best_foreign_film.intent: It has been nominated for Best Foreign Film, generating a lot of buzz.

en.movies_nonlinear_storytelling_effecti.intent: I find the director's use of non-linear storytelling particularly effective in this piece.

en.movies_original_version_subtitles.intent: I'd rather watch it in the original version with subtitles.

en.movies_oscars_best_picture_overhyped.intent: It won Best Picture at the Oscars, but honestly I thought it was overhyped.

en.movies_performances_script_characters.intent: The performances were outstanding, but the script failed to develop the supporting characters.

en.movies_prefer_cinema_home.intent: I prefer to watch movies in the cinema than at home.

en.movies_prefer_subtitles_dubbing.intent: I always watch foreign films with subtitles rather than dubbing. You miss so much.

en.movies_prefer_thrillers_not_action.intent: I'm not really into action movies. I prefer psychological thrillers.

en.movies_previous_film_more_compelling.intent: The director's previous film was far more compelling. This one felt formulaic.

en.movies_second_half_pacing_rushed.intent: The second half felt rushed compared to the slow build-up of the first act.

en.movies_seen_horror_movie.intent: Have you seen the new horror movie?

en.movies_seen_latest_episode.intent: Have you seen the latest episode of the series?

en.movies_seen_new_trailer.intent: Have you seen the new movie trailer?

en.movies_sequel_live_up_original.intent: The sequel had a bigger budget, but never quite lived up to the original.

en.movies_series_recommendation.intent: What series do you recommend me to watch?

en.movies_soundtrack_adds_atmosphere.intent: The soundtrack really adds to the atmosphere. Without the music, those scenes wouldn't work.

en.movies_special_effects_incredible.intent: The special effects were incredible. How did they do it?

en.movies_streaming_release_instead_thea.intent: It went to streaming instead of theaters. It was made for the big screen.

en.movies_subtext_more_powerful_than_dia.intent: The most powerful moments rely on subtext. What's left unsaid carries more weight than dialogue.

en.movies_two_tickets.intent: Two tickets for the eight o'clock showing, please.

en.movies_unexpected_twist_ending.intent: That film had an unexpected twist at the end that completely changed the story.
